study: Earlier brain-cell firing and the rat’s next tracking position
exposure_before_registration: Read original study and source metadata, including trial boundaries/ancillary labels, unit IDs and prior exposure notes. No raw frames/spike windows or scores from study epoch 5 inspected by modeling team. Recorded position and firing outcomes in reserve must remain untouched; epoch/trial boundary metadata may be inspected. The earlier guide showed ID 0, inspected IDs 0–3 and scattered camera rows; source confirms epoch separation.

source.clock: NWB seconds from timestamps_reference_time, shared by spike and camera tables; no assumed regularly sampled position
source.position: SpatialSeries data columns 0,1, centimeters, frame center well. Omit stored speed. Source-released positions are offline estimates, acquisition/filter latency unknown.
source.unit_scope: Same columns within same NWB and selected running epoch; no observation-interval table. No-spike bins mean zero archived events; underlying recording availability is uncertain.

sampling.anchor: start+2k s, k>=1, provided anchor+0.25s+0.05s <= stop-0.25s. Targets/windows stay >0.25s inside trial. Four spike bins (t-1,t-.75],(t-.75,t-.5],(t-.5,t-.25],(t-.25,t].
sampling.camera: For t+[-1,-.75,-.5,-.25,0] take most recent frame at or before query, age <=0.075 s. First observed frame at or after target t+0.25 required within +0.05 s. Positive inter-frame gaps <=0.100s throughout supporting interval. Use finite X,Y for these five inputs and label. Actual label timestamp retained for scoring only.
sampling.exclusions: Reject in ordered mutually exclusive categories for missing frames, stale history, missing/tardy target, excessive gap, or nonfinite selected XY. Same rows in every primary comparison. Every eligible rat trip is counted, planned and rejected anchors reported. No movement-only filtering.
sampling.features: Tokens: X,Y, backward vx,vy over successive selected frames, frame age, four historical 250ms spike count vectors, IDs in fixed order. Trial elapsed and run elapsed seconds carried in motion routes. No future values, absolute end well, route, reward, future target time, trial duration, percent completed or animal ID as a predictor. Availability of online trial detection/raw preprocessing not established.

models.baseline: Training-label centroid (absolute), persistence, constant velocity from actual last two historical positions; nominal target minus last known frame timestamp for extrapolation.
models.ridge: Equal influence per training trial. Features for motion: flatten 4 historical motion tokens, two elapsed clocks (log1p), 16 smooth spatial features (4x4 centers equally spaced over train anchor 5th–95th percentiles; spacing with floor 5cm) and their products with recent vx and vy. Combined appends sqrt counts, all four bins/all units. Fit 2D displacement from most recent observed position, standardized features, weighted ridge. Pure spikes use only sqrt counts and fit absolute future XY. Grid 0.03,0.3,3 in objective weighted mean squared + lambda||coef||²; select per model by trial-equal mean Euclidean error averaged across rolling 55–63->64–68,55–68->69–73,55–73->74–78 with larger lambda tie break.
models.attention: Secondary two matched regressors, motion-only and motion+spikes, width 16, 2 heads and 4 history tokens, one causal temporal encoder block, existing shared ForecastDecoder, learned 2D displacement. Inputs include same measured motion history, clocks and spike bins, absent spike inputs zeroed in motion-only network. Train-only channel/target normalization. CPU float32, PyTorch AdamW lr .003, decay .01, grad norm 1, seed 27223, 48 epochs, fixed shuffled batches of 64, weighted MSE by inverse retained trial length. No early stop or test model selection.
models.negative_controls: With fitted combined model fixed, (1) replace neural input with an intact joint spike window from a completed earlier test trip in same run, preserving original unit order. Choose closest available prior trial-relative nominal 2s anchor (ties most recent trial then earlier anchor), independent of donor tracking/labels. (2) circularly roll four historical bins separately within each unit by 1+(unit_id modulo 3); preserves per-window per-unit timing multiset and total. Apply both to ridge and attention. Donor trial 80 excluded from all paired score denominators; no cross-partition or future neural rows. Wrong-trial control preserves donor window contents but repeated selection need not preserve pooled test marginals.

score.primary: Equal-weight mean over complete test trips of within-trip mean Euclidean endpoint error in centimeters. Report pooled window mean separately. Primary evidence for incremental spikes: aligned combined ridge beats each persistence, constant velocity, motion-only ridge, motion-only attention, and frozen combined ridge on earlier wrong-trial spikes; all paired one-sided block-bootstrap lower difference bounds >0 using Bonferroni 0.05/5, >=8 contributing trips. Label any pass within-run exploratory.
score.intervals: 10,000 circular moving-block bootstrap draws of contiguous chronological scored trip means, block length 4, seed 1445; paired 2.5–97.5 percentiles are descriptive for individual differences, joint decision also reports one-sided bounds. Nine possible scored trips is ~2.25 nonoverlapping blocks. No between-animal inference or sample independence claim.
score.secondary: Report individual trial results, timing/coverage, motion-only and combined attention, pure spikes vs training-centroid absolute-position baseline; no secondary result can promote a failed primary. No subsequent use of reserve implied.

reproducibility: Freeze protocol and hash before fit, then fit code, weights and scoring code hashes before first test data access by model runner. Apply known model to same-source past-only example on CPU. Retain fit traces, split bounds, scored trial table, inputs, predictions and package. No live device or claim about intent, causal action, limb pose, skill, transfer or availability outside this rat/run.
